bodyText.note: paragraphs of text blocks — where new content is anchored (S1/S3 2026-10-03)

bodyAnyText.note: every body paragraph incl. table boxes, quotes and captions — for counting characters (S1/S3 2026-10-03)

inputBuffer.note: hidden 1px iframe that follows the caret and receives all typing/paste (S1/S3 2026-10-03); the canvas itself is not contenteditable

imageCaption.note: the 설명 칸 under a picture, searched inside one image block: div.se-section-image > div.se-module-text > p.se-text-paragraph with the hint '사진 설명을 입력하세요.' (2026-10-09). Hidden (0x0) until the picture is selected; a click on it moves the input frame there and a paste fills it

imageLinkOpen.note: the picture's '링크 입력 열기' in the property toolbar once a picture is selected (2026-10-09); not the document's '링크 추가' (se-oglink-toolbar-button). Carries se-is-has-value when the picture has a link

imageLinkSet.note: the selected picture already has a link (2026-10-09)

imageSelected.note: searched inside one image block: the small toolbar (편집·배치·삭제) a selected picture shows (2026-10-09). Not se-is-selected, which the 대표 button carries too

repImage.note: searched inside one image block: its '대표' control; the editor puts 대표 on the first picture by itself (2026-10-09)

repImageOn.note: searched inside one image block: this picture is the post's 대표 (2026-10-09)

imageLinkApply.note: '링크 입력' next to the field; the link is kept in the editor's data, not as an <a> in the canvas (2026-10-09)

publishOpen.note: top bar [발행]: div.publish_btn_area > div > button.publish_btn__… (2026-10-06). Opens the publish settings layer, publishes nothing. Pressed only through dom openPublishLayer's checks (PRD Q5 B); a css that matches nothing turns the layer path off

tagInput.note: the layer's tag field, input#tag-input[role=combobox], placeholder '태그 입력 (최대 30개)', no maxlength (S4)

tagItem.note: a tag in the layer after Enter: span.tag__…#tag-item-<tag> > span.text__… '#<tag>', before the field (2026-10-06)
